string.ArchiveConfirmation: Archive this object? It stays fully traceable and an administrator can restore it.
string.ArchiveInsteadOfDelete: This object is referenced by traceability links and cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
string.McpDescription: Let an AI agent read and write this workspace's issues and test cases.
string.McpAddCommandHint: Run this once. The first tool call opens a browser to authorize with Feishu; the agent then acts as you, with your permissions.
string.McpNotConfigured: No MCP server is configured for this deployment.
string.McpToolsRead: Read: list projects, search and open issues, list test projects, search and open test cases.
string.McpToolsWrite: Write: create and update issues and test cases.
string.McpNoDelete: Deleting is deliberately not offered — an agent's worst case should be extra data, not lost data.
string.McpAuthDescription: Each agent authorizes with Feishu and acts as the person who authorized it. Access expires after 8 hours; re-authorizing is a single click.
string.McpOneClickHint: Opens the app and adds this server. Nothing is configured here — the app asks you to confirm.
string.McpOtherClientsHint: Paste this into the client's MCP configuration.
string.McpCodexCaveat: Codex authenticates remote servers with a static bearer token rather than the MCP OAuth flow, so it may not be able to authorize against this server yet.
string.McpClaudeCodeHint: Opens Claude Code with the command filled in — nothing runs until you press Enter. The link only works after Claude Code has registered its handler, which happens the first time you send a prompt in an interactive session.
string.McpCodexNoDeeplink: Codex has no install link: its only URL scheme opens an existing thread. Copy the command instead.
